meta.title: Ohana — Wedding & Event Planning
meta.description: Wedding and event planning and design in Madrid and destination, with close support from start to finish.

hero.title: Wedding & Event Planning
hero.subtitle: Celebrations designed around you, cared for from start to finish and created to enjoy what truly matters: being together.

about.title: About Ohana
about.body1: Ohana means family. A word that speaks of togetherness, of bonds, and of everything worth sharing.
about.body2: We create and plan weddings and events with personality, weighing every decision with care and guiding the whole process to shape an experience that speaks of you, your story and your people.
about.body3: We like to do things with intention: to think, design, organise and care, so that everything has a reason and every detail finds its place.
about.quote: How lucky, to have found each other.

weddings.title: Weddings
weddings.intro1: There are many ways to celebrate a wedding. Yours should look like nothing but you.
weddings.intro2: We're with you from the very first decisions to the last moment of the big day, taking care of the planning, the design, and everything that happens in between.
weddings.intro3: You live it. We make it happen.
weddings.servicesSubtitle: Every wedding starts differently. That's why there are different ways to support you, too.

integral.title: Full-service planning
integral.tagline: Complete support to shape your wedding.
integral.description: We're with you throughout the whole planning and design process: sourcing and managing vendors, budget, creative concept, planning, timings, and full coordination of the big day.
integral.includes: planning · design · vendors · budget · timings · day-of coordination

diaB.title: Day-of coordination
diaB.tagline: You've planned every detail. Now it's time to live it.
diaB.description:
We step in during the final stretch to get to know everything you've prepared, review every detail, and coordinate vendors.

We build the definitive timing and make sure every moment happens as planned, handling anything unexpected so you don't have to think about a thing.

On your wedding day, your only task is to be present and enjoy it.

finde.title: Ohana weekend
finde.description:
We design and coordinate a celebration that begins before the wedding and continues after: a welcome or pre-wedding event, the wedding, and the after-party.

We make sure the different moments feel like part of the same experience, and that your guests feel looked after throughout the whole weekend.

intimas.title: Intimate weddings
intimas.description: Planning and design for intimate weddings of up to around 30 guests, where every choice carries even more weight.

destino.title: Destination weddings
destino.tagline: Spain as the backdrop. Your people all around.
destino.description: We plan weddings for couples living outside Madrid or Spain who want to celebrate here, taking care of planning, venue and vendor sourcing, logistics, and guest coordination.

medida.title: Bespoke planning
medida.tagline: Some weddings don't need to start from scratch or fit into a package.
medida.description:
We build personalised support wherever you are in the process: vendor sourcing, design, advice, budget review, planning, or specific needs.

Only where you truly need us.

events.title: Events
events.intro1: Some days deserve more than a celebration.
events.intro2: We create personal and brand events designed from concept to execution, taking care of the space, the aesthetics, the vendors, and every detail of the experience.
events.intro3: A good idea is remembered. A good experience, even more so.

privados.title: Private events
privados.tagline: Some moments simply deserve to be celebrated.
privados.description:
Birthdays, anniversaries, proposals, special dinners, private parties, and other personal celebrations.

We take care of the concept, space, vendors, decor, food, music, and coordination to turn a special occasion into an experience built around you.

corporativos.title: Corporate events
corporativos.tagline: Events that represent who you are.
corporativos.description:
We design and coordinate company gatherings, taking care of both the organisation and the guest experience.

Presentations, corporate dinners, team gatherings, celebrations, conferences, and special events.
corporativos.includes: Concept · Venue · Production · Vendors · Timing · Coordination

inspiration.title: Inspiration
inspiration.subtitle: A small visual selection that speaks to our world: tables that bring people together, places that inspire, details that tell stories, moments that stay with you.

contact.title: Contact
contact.subtitle: Tell us about your wedding and we'll get back to you within 48 hours.
